units.source_text: 中将去后，几个老尼僧相与称赞道：“他顾虑到‘人世多谣诼’，到底是个规矩人。”

en.t: After the lieutenant had gone, several old nuns praised him together, saying, "He is mindful that the world is full of gossip, and in the end he is a proper man."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧也说道：“此人相貌堂堂，老成持重，真是个好男子啊！

en.t: The younger nun also said, "He has a fine, dignified appearance and is mature and steady. What a truly admirable man he is!

units.source_text: 我反正总要招婿，就同从前一样招了他吧。”

en.t: Since I must take a son-in-law in any case, I might as well take him, just as before."

units.source_text: 又说：“他赘在藤中纳言家，虽然常常到那边去，但和那女子感情不洽，大都是宿在他父亲那里的。”

en.t: She added, "He married into the Fuji Middle Counselor's family and often goes there, but he does not get along well with that woman, so he usually spends the night at his father's house."

units.source_text: 她就对浮舟说：“你一直忧愁苦闷，不肯和我们开诚实说，叫我好伤心啊！

en.t: Then she said to Ukifune, "You have been sad and troubled all this time, and you refuse to speak frankly with us. It pains me so much!

units.source_text: 这五六年来，我时刻不忘地悼念我那死去的女儿。

en.t: For these past five or six years, I have mourned my dead daughter without ever forgetting her for a moment.

units.source_text: 但自从找到你之后，我竟全然把她忘记了。

en.t: But ever since I found you, I have somehow forgotten her completely.

units.source_text: 世间原有挂念着你的人。

en.t: There were once people in the world who cared about you.

units.source_text: 但现在他们都以为你已亡故，对你渐渐忘怀了。

en.t: But now they all believe that you have died, and they have gradually begun to forget you.

units.source_text: 世间无论何事，当时的心情总不会长久持续的。”

en.t: In this world, whatever the matter may be, the feelings of the moment never last very long."

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，越发悲伤起来，含泪答道：“我对妈妈绝不存心隐瞒。

en.t: Hearing this, Ukifune grew even sadder and answered through her tears, "I have never meant to hide anything from you, Mother.

units.source_text: 只因身逢奇遇，死而复生，便觉万事都像做梦，自己仿佛已是生在另一世界里的人，竟记不起世间还有曾经照拂过我的人。

en.t: It is only that, after such a strange fate befell me and I returned to life from death, everything felt like a dream, and I seemed to be someone already living in another world. I could not even remember that there were people in this world who had once cared for me.

units.source_text: 现在我所亲爱的，就只有你妈妈一人了。”

en.t: Now the only person dear to me is you, Mother."

units.source_text: 她说时态度天真可爱，做妈妈的只是满面笑容地看着她。

en.t: As she spoke, her manner was innocent and lovable, and the woman who had become her mother simply looked at her with a face full of smiles.
